Benefits: It ensures smooth transitions to the next shot even while performing continuous, rapid movements. This allows for greater control and fluidity, enhancing the overall playability of the racket. Namd: Description: Namd is a revolutionary graphite material that enhances the adhesion of the graphite fibers and resin, creating a high-performance shaft. Benefits: The result is a racket with increased flex and faster snapback, providing explosive power and improved energy transfer with every shot. Namd allows for deeper shuttle hold and more powerful smashes. Energy Boost Cap Plus: Description: The Energy Boost Cap Plus is designed to maximize shaft performance by enhancing the flex and snapback. Benefits: It stabilizes the racket head by preventing the shaft from twisting, thus ensuring accurate and powerful shots. This cap design also optimizes the angle of the racket face, providing more control and power. H.M. Graphite: Description: High Modulus Graphite is used in the frame and shaft, offering superior strength and resilience. Benefits: This material ensures the racket can handle high tension strings, providing excellent durability and performance. The use of H.M. Graphite also contributes to the racket's lightweight feel, enhancing maneuverability. VDM (Vibration Dampening Mesh): Description: VDM is a stretchy mesh material wrapped around the graphite within the grip to filter unwanted vibrations. Benefits: It improves the overall feel of the racket, reducing vibrations and enhancing comfort during play. This allows for better control and less fatigue, especially during long matches. Playability The Astrox Nextage is designed for aggressive players who prioritize power and speed. Its head-heavy balance and stiff flex provide the perfect combination for delivering powerful smashes and fast drives. The Rotational Generator System and Namd technology work together to offer exceptional control and responsiveness, allowing players to dominate the court with confidence. Whether you're executing rapid smashes or precise net shots, the Astrox Nextage delivers unmatched performance. Summary The Astrox Nextage Badminton Racket is an excellent choice for advanced players looking to enhance their power and speed on the court. With its innovative technologies and premium materials, this racket offers exceptional performance in competitive play. Whether you're playing singles or doubles, the Astrox Nextage will help you take your game to the next level.
